name: physical_simple
description: Short physical procedure - filling a water bottle. Six clean transitions across eight frames, transcript and observations agree on every action.
transcript: I am going to fill this water bottle. First I pick up the empty bottle from the counter. I unscrew the cap and place it next to the bottle. Then I hold the bottle under the tap and turn the tap on. I wait until the water reaches the top of the bottle. I turn the tap off and screw the cap back on. Finally I place the filled bottle back on the counter.

frame_observations.description: Empty water bottle standing on the counter, cap still attached.
Right hand reaches for the empty bottle on the counter.
Operator holds the bottle, unscrewing the cap with the other hand.
Cap is fully off the bottle, placed on the counter beside it.
Bottle held under the kitchen tap, tap handle being turned on.
Water is flowing into the bottle, level visibly rising past halfway.
Tap handle turned off, water flow stopped, bottle nearly full.
Cap screwed back onto the bottle, bottle being placed on the counter.
